text: Not at all like the adverts, but despite this was finding this fun initially- no ads a definite bonus. Was enjoying it so much I bought the Kingdom Pass, seeing it as a purchase of a game that I liked. There was no indication, however, that the benefits for it only lasted for a calendar month, so buying it near the end of March only gave me the benefits for a couple of days before it became clear that I'd need to pay another £9.99 for April. Absolutely not worth a monthly fee!

I've done over 3300 levels, the further you get the harder they make it and you have to pay to complete the level then when you get to the next one it starts all over again, and if you're in a team you'll be expected to score a certain amount of points within a short time period which as I've said get more and more difficult. yes they're are no ads, but if you want to progress you'll have to pay for it and the developers keep giving less rewards pushing you into buying. Avoid.

Fixed! They tell you this game is random. They're lying. The way the items fall ISN'T random. The most irritating thing is when you are on your last few moves, light balls, barrel bombs etc all fall in and you run out of moves, and because you only need to remove a few more items, then it's easy to spend coins. There are also jewels that randomly disappear, and they tell you that doesn't happen! It's a complete rip off! Not surprising that the developers haven't replied to any of these reviews!

Good graphics and achievable levels but the adverts for this game are misleading. I got to level 420 in relatively short space of time (which shows that it can be addictive to start with) but no sign of levels where you have to rescue the king...which is how I was "lured" into downloading this game. Probably won't continue playing as after a while it becomes boring with very similar levels.

Update: going to uninstall this game as have got to a point where i can no longer continue. Gameplay not as advertised. it's a good game but I feel misled by the ads. also, some levels are very difficult to do without spending money on power ups. due to this, it can be boring to keep repeating the same level until complete. you have to complete 500 levels to move to the next stage. does anyone have that kind of patience and commitment these days when there are so many other games available?

So... After seeing multiple ads across all games to download this game, including 'puzzles' in which the 'King' has to be rescued in so many different ways, I succumbed! The ASA needs to see these ads because they're fake! They bear no resemblance to the downloaded game, and the game itself only has a few very easy levels! Do NOT waste your time on this!

I like that it is ad free and you don't need WiFi to play. HOWEVER... in my experience, as soon as you amass a decent number of coins (needed to continue levels or buy power-ups), the app deliberately makes games unwinnable for a period, to force you to use them all up, then it goes back to normal once you've lost all or most of them.

This game lures you in with the promise of no adverts and the ability to play offline. It does both these things and kills a bit of time every now again. What infuriates me is that the developers purposely code in the algorithms so that after so long, it makes it near impossible to progress without purchasing in game things. It will eventually let you get past a level but it's only so long until you get stuck on another level. At this point it just becomes I frustrating. I'll be uninstalling.

Too many points to state. First, FALSE ADVERTISING. It's nothing like 'save the king before he dies' and all that but a temu version of royal match! Secondly, THE DIFFICULTY OF LEVELS. I've been stuck on a level for the past few days and failed more than 20 times trying too hard to complete it. It's P2W since you need real money to get through or to buy more coins for more moves in a game that won't be installed for long. If 0 was an option it'd be that. This game hasn't improved since I got it.

The game is good, but why does it cheat? The helicopters (whatever they're called) specifically target the electro balls even if there are still items to clear. Bombs trigger them when they are too far away to do so. These issues were sorted in royal match. Basically, after level 1000, it's unplayable unless you spend money. Their answer to this argument is that you can win without spending. Yes, you can if you play the same level, over and over, for roughly 20 to 40 times. Just a money grabber.

It's okay. Haven't come across any of the games which are advertised in may of the adverts though. It can be artificially difficult just to make sure you don't progress too quickly, and after a point you will fail more games than you will succeed. Perfect for on the loo, as you'll run out of lives so quick you can't play for long. I presume they'll charge a premium for lives. I can't comment on adverts because I have other tools in place blocking them. Overall average. Candy crush is better

Completely misrepresented by the ad. Looks like a thousand puzzle games, all variations on the candy crush theme. In actual fact it seems to be quite a boring world building game where you can't skip getting pink flamingo sculptures by your pond. Pants. Would give it zero stars if that were an option. Also infested with multiple adverts between each (2 minute) level. Complete waste of time.

It was fun... but then it became clearly a cash grab. Like all the others they advertise a user friendly experience. However, as soon as you start to feel like you're making headway, the levels become ridiculously hard so you are forced to buy lives/power ups/extra turns. Just the normal bullsh** you should expect from these games. The reason it's not a 1 is because it doesn't have ads which was nice.

Not bad to begin with but eventually got to a level that was impossible to pass without paying for upgrades so uninstalled it. Now I've got to put up with annoying ads that are long enough to let you go make a coffee and if all we've got to worry about is the AI that can't solve the puzzles, we're safe from judgement day... Either shorten the ads or at least make them playable to relieve the boredom...

Time and Money grabbing. it starts off really fun. the game is good mix of skill and strategy and you get pulled in to taking it seriously very quickly. you join teams who you don't want to let down so you end up playing longer. problem comes when you just can't get a good run going. the game forces you in to buying extra things to help you. to the point where some levels are not possible if you don't have an electro ball. Dream need to find the right balance considering quitting

Good game to start off, but it is clearly monetary driven, hence no ads. I'm at the stage of the game where levels can take days to complete without buying extras. Where is the fun in that? On the verge of deleting. Deleted, no fun in spending days stuck on a level, when you finally get past it, the cycle repeats itself. Garbage!!

false advertising - I'm fully sick and tired of having and advert for a game (including interactive part) and thinking this is fun, to then download the actual game to find it's a completely different game! and all the fun parts of the advert DO NOT EXIST!! don't get me wrong the game is still fun to a point but the excitement of saving the king from larva and stuff like that that's in the advert DOES NOT EXIST!!! and for the Devs, can I add that watching your adverts is incredibly painful!!!

Incredibly addictive. it is a fun game with many different interesting things to explore. However, at some point, around level 200. it becomes 100% pay to win. levels become too hard to compete without boosters. and rewards are too small to get boosters without paying. so it's possible to enjoy the first ~ 200 levels. for free. then just get your wallet out. just like they were warning about drugs.

It's fair, progress is slow but plenty to do as well, graphics are great, music is annoying but you can always turn it of. Little videos between areas being complete are cool could even make a movie. Fun for adults and kids. Why 3 stars? We tested this game on both a paid version and free version, if you pay it dose not take long befor they tempt you to pay again! Some levels you can even be stuck in for a day or 2, if you work like my self you just don't have the time to be kept on one level

Royal Match, the older title from this developer, is quite decent, gets difficult, but doable without throwing money at it. Royal Kingdom, this game, seems a "correction" on their part to ensure more money! It starts well enough, but escalates after a hundred or so levels to a point beyond fun. After that, it only gets worse, inching more and more towards completely impossible, in an attempt to part you from your money in exchange for powerups that are no longer a choice.

The game is good. But the developers have just reset the entire game which has meant I lost all my coins (21000+) and potions that I had built up over months of playing. The developers are completely disinterested in this time spent playing a game I had previously enjoyed. If they've done this once highly likely they will do it again. Beware!!

It's a fun game and truly is ad-free, but as others have said it's rigged against you. Key levels are impossible to beat without power ups, and the game intentionally drains power ups to try and get you to spend money to continue. It was nice up until that point, but as I have no plans to spend money on a phone game, it killed any interest in continuing. Uninstalled.

Been playing the update for a while, I do love this game, but it's got way harder and it's now nigh on impossible without buying add ons. I can't afford that so it's ruined the game for me - before I could buy an add on once a month and be alright, it was slower but still just about playable. Not any more. Thinking of deleting, I just get stuck for days on one game. Rubbish

This was a very good game, and I initially gave a 5 star rating. Aesthetically pleasing to the eye, free to play, and no ads. Unfortunately, the developers decided to update the game and reset everyone. Months of play, building up specials, coins, etc, along with the group i was part of; all gone. Not a great move in my honest opinion. Won't bother newbies, but if you're a seasoned player like myself, this will be frustrating as hell. This game is now removed from my device.

I cannot believe that this game is being advertised on TV, a lot, with famous people no less! Just goes to show the level of profit the Devs get for games like this. There may not be any ads in the game, but, as usual, the in-app purchases are stupidly expensive. Just once it would be nice to see a game of this type done differently, so they are actually affordable to play. I'm fed up of games made by greedy people. This is just a regular boring match 3 game which I'll be uninstalling.

Absolutely disgusting that you reset the entire game. All of the progress, time and money invested in a game I enjoyed for it to be wiped away. Reach level 100 again for no further levels!!!! I want a refund of every single penny I've spent, the few thousand coins you gave isn't going to cut it. Vile behaviour from a company. I would give 0 stars if it allowed.

Beyond incensed: I was well over Level 2000+ and you've just done some major update and taken me back to Level 1. It said that it would save and keep all my items but hasn't. I've spent time and money to get this far, only for it to cancel it all.. This is not acceptable, and someone had better reach out to me with an explanation and some sort of solution.

What is with these games that don't work like the ads???? It looks fun and goofy in them, saving the king from being eaten by a snake. JUST GIVE ME THE GAME IN THE ADS DAMMIT. Whilst I will admit it's not the absolute worst, it's still an ugly trend, and at this point, surely the ad regulators should be overseeing this?

You advertise a fun interesting game (SAVE THE KING) then make us go through Brain Sapping levels serving no point or fascination. Every level is another tedious adventure dragging to it's conclusion. I would suggest you offer 2 options, Brain Sap or SAVE THE KING, OR 2 Brain Saps then SAVE THE KING etc. BUT, your graphics, presentation and craftsmanship is Excellent, you instilled Great Dynamics and Emotions into the king during his plight (in the ads), I get no joy matching 3,4, or 5 leafs etc

I'd like to ask a question. In the trailers, it's showing what everyone would like to play, the part where you have you clear the water or lava to save someone. So why isn't the real game play like that? That's what I want. There was a PC game years ago called the four elements where to had to make way for an element to get to it's destination. That was the best game ever.

They reset the whole game. I just updated the game after a long time playing without updates. Recieved a message saying there have been big changes and to make it more enjoyable (or something along those lines) they have reset all progress. Back to level 1 nothing I have unlocked or earned up until now is there anymore. There was absolutely no point in playing the game up to now. Will be deleting it. What a disgrace

Having seen many adverts for this game I was somewhat unimpressed, however I decided to try it. I was happy to find that this game was nothing like the one advertised. I have played through 40 levels and am yet to see any of the gameplay shown in the ads, what a relief! it is a match 3 game that differs slightly from royal match with some new features while others have been removed that featured in its predecessor.

So I logged in, after a few days, only to find that they've reset everything! It took me ages to get to the level I was (granted it was 200+, but I was proud of that) only to find that I'm back to level one. This isn't progress, this is an utter shambles. I read the comments before posting mine to see what they've done and I will be deleting the game. Not going to bother trying it out, in the virtual bin it goes.

Money traps! I played both Royal Match and Royal Kingdom and, while they are fine at the lower levels, you soon reach hard levels with not enough moves that are designed to make you spend money. I stopped playing them because I found other Match-3 games without ads, but which give you the option to watch an ad for extra moves when you get stuck.

Nothing like the advert at all. 161 levels in and not one was like advertised. Very basic match 3 game with no time limit either. Usual energy/life requirements but the game doesn't engage you enough to play for a long time. Like all the reviews that are one star so they stop only showing the 5 star reviews that they chose. False advertising everywhere!

much as I appreciate that there are no ads, I have been playing a lot since installing the app and all I'm doing is matching symbols and shooting at 'castles'? Not a sign anywhere of the challenges to rescue the king as they appear in the ad for the game. Now getting bored with the repetitiveness. How do I get to play the game as advertised? Update-now on level 206, not one of which features a single game as shown on their advertising. Just another tile-match app🙄 Uninstalled😡

Ive changed my rating I used to love this game. Now it's just a few levels then the arena and then a few levels and repeat. I'm good at this but I now cant finish a level because the game won't let me. Leaves me with 1 move almost every time on the same level for atleast 2 days trying to get me to but coins. So I think it's time for me to delete this one. I've been playing it for over a year but I won't be forced into buying coins, especially when the return is little to nothing.

Disappointing, I did 654 levels, and then removed it, the reason being that when you run out of lives you have to wait so long before getting more, then you struggle for hours to complete one, the same again for the next level, also never came across the levels in the demo, lovely graphics but unplayable.

No ads, full predator. This game is a very simple match 3 at its core however it is full of random and pointless content that's simply used to get free power ups. However the game makes it difficult to still earn these free power-ups. The game will do everything it can to screw you over and encourage you to pay far too much money to get coins or power ups. ultimately, this game is good to kill 20 minutes but beyond that is just another predatory, scummy, dime a dozen mobile game.

So far it's nothing like the advert. Just a basic match 3 game. They don't lie when they say there's no ads and you don't need WiFi... But the ad itself is a lie as it's nothing like the game. Deleting it because I have other match 3+ games I prefer and with the reviews about how updates reset the game, I don't want to run the risk that happens to me.

The ads for this game are a total lie. Downloaded this thinking it's just like Royal Match (same devs), about saving the king from water, stones etc by matching 3 to clear a path (but with better graphics), but it's just candy crush plus separate VS battle games every 10 or so levels. After almost 40 levels, no sign of what was promised.

Have these annoying people advertising this game say to " let them know" if it's rubbish. Please pass on that it is. Nothing like advert for it. Don't advertise a game showing one thing it's down loaded and nothing like. Various shapes line of 3 to get rid of blocks. Advert - saving the king from various things. Hate being mislead. Advertise it properly. Thanks

Edit: 3 months now with no new content. Game clearly abandoned by the devs. Used to love it, but there's been no new levels for over 2 months now, rehashing the same levels every other week is just boring AF, and they just make it ping pong around, you get one or two levels done, then it very intentionally messed you around on a level to make you lose your win streak bonuses, the game is just boring now and I can't fathom buying another pass when there's absolutely nothing new to do.

Constantly giving you annoying hints you can't turn off. So many puzzles to work through before you get a go at the Rescue the King game you think the whole game is going to be about. So annoying I just deleted it for the second time after remembering why I deleted it the first time. A shame it could be a good challenging game but no.

After updating the app to then find all my progress had gone lost a star. I like alot of the new things you've put in the but I can't get to alot of it as 101 levels is not enough to get me to the required level to unlock the next world so that's another star gone and the third star has gone for the repetiveness of the levels. I'm sorry but if I can't get any further then I'll just be deleting the game.

This game is so good, but so hard, and super easy at the same time. In app purchases but you can play it without them and still get to the high levels. No ads. You can play offline, but if you're in a team you need to be online to request lives etc. Can play without as well though So many levels. The arena is a bit frustrating but it's a nice stop gap between new level releases.

This is not a good app, you do not, like the adverts suggest, help the King escape from anything, instead you have to get through many repetitive levels and have to pay money to increase your coins totals. I only did this once. It tells you it unlocks at 32 levels but nothing changed and the repitiveness of the same type of challenge just drove me mad so I decided to quit and uninstall the app

I am going to uninstall this game. I enjoyed playing it together with the increase in challenge but after you played the same level for the umpteenth time and never get anywhere, you loose interest. I haven't found a way of gaining credits so I'd have to spend real money and probably not get anywhere either. Don't bother it's just frustrating

it's a great game, but sadly the technical issues drive me crazy. it keeps taking me back to stages that I've already done, this means it erases all the prizes I've earned, it keeps saying it can't connect to the wifi, which means I can't progress with the challenges, even though wifi is fine. i really enjoy the game so I hope they sort it out.

This game has now been relaunched, currently there are 250 levels in the game, with new levels being released every 2 weeks 50 at a time. Having played this game since last year, the relaunch is just a rehash of what was already there. New levels can be completed quickly. You are then sent to a tournament level which you are stuck with until the new levels arrive. All in all a very frustrating game.

LIARS. This game is not the one from the advert, you don't save the king. there's no snake, no falling rocks, no water etc. it's a generic match 3 game, like aaaalllll the others. match in different directs to get power ups, get rewards to build a kingdom rinse and repeat. BORING. REPETITIVE. NOT THE GAME IT ADVERTISED. but there's no ads and it's graphics are good. I still uninstalled. MAKE THE GAME YOU ADVERTISED!

as others have said. fun at first. but then you slowly grind to a halt unless you spend actual money, which I won't do. got to a fairly high level. but have been stuck on a very hard level for about a week now. which is madness. also, how many games "run out of time" so you have to either buy more time or come back later. strange. money money money.

Absolute scam of a game. I loved it at first but just deleted it now. It was much easier and much more enjoyable compared to Royal Match. But once I got to level 2500 it went 300 times worse than Royal Match. It basically became impossible to pass a level without paying. I went from 60,000 to 200 coins in 10 days. At the same time the coins from beating levels are scarce. You pay 900 coins to continue playing when you run out of moves but you get only about 20 coins for beating a level.

2 stars because it starts good, but it just becomes unplayable unless you're prepared to pay for extras. In the early stages, you build up a good amount of things to help you through. Once the levels start to get tougher, you use the extras you have accumulated. By the time you get to the really hard levels, you have nothing to help you without purchasing and the levels become very difficult/impossible to win. I know it's ad free but I'm not prepared to pay for games.

False advertising. In the adverts for this game,you are lead to believe that there are lots of match three puzzles involving rescuing the king etc...,I got to around level 30 without a single rescue level,apart from the battle matches every ten levels the game is basically "Royal Match" (which I have),which is made by the same company. Uninstalled.

Really enjoyed the game til the recent update. I had completed so many levels to then be started back at level 1. I decided to give it benefit of the doubt and carried on playing, thinking we'd be in the kingdom now it's had a major update, but it's taken me straight back to the tournament area it's been stuck on for the last few months! The games are all the same, It seems to repeat all of the games over and over. So frustrated.

Just like the first gr8 little game but if you want 2 further enjoy it's pay time again folks not enough freebies package deal that aren't cheap just like Electronic Arts Tetris Blitz which I spent thousands on no more pay 2 play this game needs more freebies especially at a time when we're all paying over the odds for food and energy. 🤑

EXTREMELY SLOW & FRUSTRATING ON UPDATES, initially it was 50 levels every 2wks. Its now 6 MONTHS & STILL NO NEW LEVELS! widely advertised which has now miraculously disappeared which suggests game has clearly been abandoned, shame really as it had the potential be as succesful as Royal Match, developers bitten off more than they could chew. Starts off brilliant until you max out the levels which is pretty quick seeing as only 451 levels, then you're in groundhog day.
It's a trap. This game boasts with the absence of ads, but ultimately it is pay to win and pretty much impossible to get further into the game without pouring money into it.

Good game except for the lack of levels to play. You play 20 levels and then it sends you to the champions arena playing the same levels you've already completed until more proper levels are loaded (weeks). It just gets really boring.

Advert for game says no ads and no play to win... Rubbish!!! If I could find the way to do it, I know you used be able to, I would report it as a misleading advert. Quite boring and very repetative too.
Absolutely rigged, they control the amount of power ups that "spawn" in game, and just when you're about to get an objective all of a sudden no power ups can be made.

I think Google play should give room for no star at all cause this game doesn't even deserve a star....after your deceptive ad, i then downloaded to find out the game is not as the ad, every 5 minutes, ad pops up. Stop being deceptive royal kingdom developer or ad maker or whoever is doing this. thank you

Laziest app developers I've EVER come across! Not a single new level since downloading the app. I now understand why there are so many negative reviews. Their other app gets 100 new levels twice monthly. This one gets NOTHING! Don't bother wasting your time with it! Oh, btw if you question "support" you get blocked!!!

good but ridiculous game! how do you expect to finish 42 vases, 20 chalices, 8 orbs, and 56 leaves with just 26 moves and not giving a lot of matches on the 1st load?! the battle with Dark King is the funniest (Level 60) because you have to defeat the castle knights with 32 moves for 2 stages! impossible even with powerups. oh well, at least it's free, doesn't have ads and you can play offline.

I downloaded this game and gave it 5 stars to reward you. Because I ran into one, just one! Advertisement that did not insult my intelligence with stupid psychological bs and finished a level on screen. Keep doing that, be real. Game seems fun too so, awesome.

I loved the game so much ,it has the real creativity of the game developers. enjoying the updates, graphics and all. Some reviews are negative but let me tell this is really not scam or bad game, it's just your understanding of game play. i ma reviewing the game on highest level of the day..and it is so much fun..and addicting game play
this is the best game ever guys please I recommend you try it it's so cool 😎
If youre expecting to play what the ads/pictures are portraying.. don't download. this was a waste of storage and I HIGHLY recommend you do NOT waste your time with this, like I unfortunately did.
Royal Kingdom is unable to keep up with its players and supporters. This is the 3rd time having to wait on new levels. Focus on game progress rather than all of the side missions and activities.
I love the app because it has no add and if you have no network no problem

Very poor game! Having to play the same games over & over whilst waiting for updates & when one gets an update, you then lose all coins, potions, etc, you've collected! Customer Service is appalling too!
I don't get it. The ads all show a great game helping the king escape perils, but the actual game is just a simple small grid and there is no rescue or escape element.

how can you use 900 coins to activate 5 moves but the coin rewards after you win a level is not even up 10% of the 900 coins all you the develop want is purchase with real money thats a cheat activation of the super ball take ten wins one loss deactivate it what of the number of wins you won with it do they count ? total cheat you can win a a super ball and through out a whole level it won't show up it only shows up when u have 2 to three moves remaining ..cheat ..total scam 😒 why ?

Players are offered a good amount of coins and powers to purchase compared to other like games. Also, you can win a fair amount of coins by achieving challenges, again compared to similar games. These reasons alone make playing Royal Kingdom more fun, over other match 3 games!
fake app..not the advertised one after tgr installation ..highly not recommended
Some levels are too hard to complete without incentives, otherwise good game.

I love this game and in a great team but when you have the weekly team battles and you are being told that the team winning is cheating and we had proof nothing was done at all. you can't have a team with 28k average 600 ish each 48 players but their actual score did not reflect this, honest people pay money but why should they when you allow bots to rule. this needs sorting once done I'll up my rating to 5 stars.

It has the same concept as Candy Crush. I have not seen any of the courses the ad shows. I am wondering if it is a false advertisement. I will continue to play for now. The upside is that there are no ads for a free game. That's nice.

I've been playing this for 3 years it takes 2 hours to win one game it's not worth the money it's not worth the stress I'm 65 years old I would be a My grave before ever finish this game so I'll make sure everybody understands don't spend that kind of money on something you'll never win

Royal bloody Kingdom....uwwwh we have no ads, no you don't but you love ruining other games by having you ads over & over again plus they're 1½ mins long, yes you can play offline but gosh it's boring.....No your graphics are not brilliant they kinda Mmnnh average. I've personally grown to hate this game purely for the amount of its own ads everywhere, not sure who's responsible yourselves or Google otherwise known as the Omnipotent Monopoly in the sky Alphabet??? Do the honourable thing & 🤬🤬

Lost all my levels. I had played well over 300 levels. Added app to tablet, signed in and it started me over at level one on both android and tablet. All that gameplay gone! Is it worth starting over AND losing my team? Beyond upset.
It's a good game to play, but not all players get given the opportunity to play the bonus games which makes the game unfair, especially in team challenges, etc.
It's a lot of trickery growing on. But it's fun. they could just be more generous with giving you the puzzle without making you pay to obtain one piece.

Only having 100 levels ready for a big update seems like you were a little premature with the release. Wiping everyone's progress and knocking all of us back to level 1, losing coins, teams, etc is just mean.

I wish this game was just the special levels that it advertises constantly. unfortunatelyit'sa carbon copy of games like homescapes. it's entertaining enough, as a match 3, but not what I thought I was downloading

It's so awesome no ads ,wi-fi blast though levels super fun .Try it save the king pretty simple.The levels get pretty hard it's addictive.Not in a bad way.Loads of reviews have come from people with lots of experience and time. I'm just a BEGINNER! The first levels are EASEY ,simple.I've played royal mach this is a 100% UPgrade. I've read the other reviews.Innstall sometime and keep happy . Like crazy but it can get hard.Bit you need to try a couple times until you get it right.Bye for now.👋
Great game. Only bad thing is it's expensive. For example for 1000 coins Royal Kingdom is $1.99 versus my other game that's like this one is only .99 cents. Other than that it's really fun to play.
Love the game. Seems like there have been updates. Hopefully, it will be a more honest game. Time will tell.
Pretty poor updates and we can't fight each other any more, levels are really easy. Go back to the old way, clearly looking at your reviews you will be losing a lot of players!
1 star for bmisleading ads. it is just your big standard match three game and no levels are like the ones down in the ads.

It's so true about the beautiful graphics. I also love the mini games, the fact that you don't have to try 100 times to win a level like do many other games, the ease and quickness of receiving (and giving) lives. I could go on and on. To sum it up, I LOVE this game!
Disappointed. You get an average of 20 coins per level completed which is very hard. Then they want 900 coins for a measly 5 extra moves. Sucks. Uninstalling. Don't need the aggravation

Fun game, but has a huge bug - after every level it freezes, and I have to clear cache, force stop, and try to reopen. This works sometimes, but usually the entire process has to be repeated 3 - 4 times in order to continue.
Level 77 is impossible. I have uninstalled several times on various levels that are close to impossible without spending money, but this level can not be beaten. Very disappointing.

this app won't even let me in. constantly non responsive. early morning or late night but never during the day. I'm almost at level 1000 and have never spent a dime but I'm frustrated at either this app or my phone that it will not let me play when I want to. this sucks
this game is absolutely nothing like the video that they're advertising the game to be. this game is SAF and not worth the time it takes to download.
Absolutely nothing like it's ads. Just another match 3 game, that wants me to join a team, keeps all these other events going on at the same time and becomes confusing and annoying. FALSE ADVERTISING

The game has really potential! Nice gameplay, no bugs so far, interesting and varied! But... as others complained already, in the higher levels it's getting frustratingly hard! No fun anymore. I love challenging games, but here it's too much. Also I need to complain these annoying wiggle hints! Who wants them? They are just distracting and make the player feel stupid. At least a button to turn them off should be given. So I'm waiting if there will be updates with improvements 😊
